thread:
maria_cs: quick heads up — onboarding cohort EMEA-March is hitting intermittent 403 SSO errors during the Dedicated pool migration. ~8 tenants affected, a mix of trials and low-touch paid. need short customer-facing status + office hours invite + remediation ETA. thinking: rollback window + credits for trials? :thinking:


 dan_product: how widespread is this and are any renewal-risk customers impacted? need to flag AE/AMs if so.


 raj_support: confirmed list: tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-f, tenant-g, tenant-h, tenant-k, tenant-m, tenant-p. two are in P0 trial window, one is in renewal review next month. initial outreach draft below, subject options attached. recommend immediate notification + opt-in office hours.


 leo_engineering: quick tech note — cause is a client-id swap that wasn't fully invalidating old sessions during the Dedicated handoff. some tokens return 403 while auth server still has stale mapping. mitigation path: rollback migration of client-id for affected pool, then issue a small session-expiry flush. rolling patch scheduled in ~25–35m. will monitor auth success rates after rollback. logs looked like:


```
WARN auth: token validation failed tenant=tenant-f status=403 reason=client_id_mismatch header=x-client-id: old-id-abc123
INFO deploy: rolling rollback to client-id=old-id-abc123 for pool=dedicated-emea-2
```


 leo_engineering: after rollback we'll run a targeted token refresh for impacted tenants (script runs ~10m). if anything unexpected, we'll revert again and open manual ops runbook.


 sophie_ce: for renewal-risk tenant (tenant-g) we should send a personalized note from the AE + offer a one-on-one enablement session. also propose a small goodwill credit for trials only — maybe 15% of remaining credit? keep paid customers' credits on case-by-case.


 maria_cs: drafted customer note (short) — please check and approve.


```
Subject: Quick update: temporary SSO interruptions — what we’re doing

Hi —
We’re aware of intermittent SSO/403 errors some customers saw during a Dedicated migration. Our engineers identified the issue and are rolling a fix now. We expect full recovery within 60 minutes.

If you’re seeing a 403, please sign up for our office hours (link) or reply to this thread and we’ll prioritize your tenant. We’ll follow with a brief RCA and any account credits as applicable.

Thanks for the patience,
Redwood Customer Success
```


 raj_support: subject line options: 1) "Redwood update: brief SSO interruption — action steps" 2) "Status: SSO 403 observed — we’re on it". suggestion: include clear opt-in link to office hours and a tiny checkbox for urgent escalation.


 incident_bot: Incident created: SSO-403-DEDI-MIGRATION (severity: medium) — ticket #INC-2026-881.


 maria_cs: plan/owners:
- leo_engineering: execute rollback + confirm auth success (owner)
- raj_support: send first wave notification to affected tenants within 15m (use the draft)
- sophie_ce: compile personalized note for tenant-g and loop AE (owner)
- dan_product: track renewal risk & escalate to sales ops if needed
- maria_cs: host office hours at 1400 UTC (link will be posted), collate replies and follow-ups, and draft the RCA template once we have post-mortem details.


 maria_cs: will post status update in this thread in 30m or after rollback confirmation. :thumbsup:
